note: Trigger routing eval set. Actual model trigger testing requires claude CLI or equivalent harness; this file defines expected routes and near-miss collisions.

evals.prompt: This trust policy lets GitHub Actions assume a prod role. Can you check if it is least privilege and whether the conditions are safe?
Our KMS key policy blocks the DR restore role and secret rotation failed last night. Review the key/secret lifecycle safely.
A partner needs read access to only invoices/2026 in one S3 bucket. Avoid public access and tell me the safest bucket/access point posture.
Here is a CloudFormation change set for prod that replaces an RDS subnet group and changes IAM. Is this safe to execute?
We are connecting on-prem to AWS using Direct Connect and Transit Gateway. Check CIDRs, route propagation, DNS, and failover risk.
Our public API Gateway sits behind CloudFront and WAF. Review throttling, origin protection, logging, and abuse controls.
The EKS upgrade will touch node groups, Karpenter, CNI, IRSA, and workload disruption. Is the cluster ready?
Our ECS Fargate deployment keeps rolling back after target health checks fail. Check task roles, circuit breaker, ALB, and logs.
Review this Lambda production setup: SQS trigger, reserved concurrency, DLQ, env secrets, CloudWatch alarms, and rollback.
Design our EventBridge/SNS/SQS event flow with schemas, cross-account bus policy, retries, DLQs, replay, and idempotent consumers.
Aurora PostgreSQL latency spiked after deploy. Check Performance Insights, DB load, waits, slow queries, connections, and replica lag.
Review this DynamoDB design: partition key is customerId, two GSIs, high write rate, occasional scans, and hot tenant risk.
We need a DR design with RTO 2 hours, RPO 15 minutes, multi-Region failover, game days, and dependency runbooks.
Check AWS Backup vault lock, cross-account copy, restore testing, retention, KMS access, and failed backup jobs.
Security Hub has GuardDuty, Inspector, Macie, and Config findings across accounts. Prioritize hardening actions.
Prepare SOC2 evidence from Audit Manager, Security Hub controls, Config conformance packs, CloudTrail, and AWS Artifact reports.
Review this Bedrock agent with action groups, knowledge base, Guardrails, memory, and prompt-injection concerns.
Turn our RDS incident runbook into an AWS DevOps Agent skill with frontmatter, target agent type, references, and tool-use guidance.
Cost spiked in two AWS accounts. Use Cost Explorer/Budgets/Cost Optimization Hub and avoid cutting backups or logging.
Design our AWS Control Tower OU/account structure with log archive, audit account, SCP guardrails, and account vending.
